My name is Gerardus Mercator. You may know me for my widely (and unjustly!) hated map projection, but I did a lot more than exaggerate the poles!

# Education

## 's-Hertogenbosch: *1526—1530*

Studied Bible, Latin, logic, rhetoric.

## University of Leuven: *1530—1532*

Graduated Magister in 1532

# Experience

- Apprenticed to Gaspar van der Heyden
- Engraved terrestrial globe of Gemma and Gaspar Van der Heyden (1536)
- Produced many award-winning globes and maps
- Developed theory of magnetism
- Coined the term "atlas"

# Fun Facts

I really did wear that funny hat! It was quite the fashion at the time.

I coined the term "atlas"! You're welcome!
